Klasse PlotGraph<T extends PlotGraph<T>>

Alle implementierten Schnittstellen:
schimkat.berlin.lernhilfe2025ws.graphics.Drawable, CustomDrawable
public abstract class PlotGraph<T extends PlotGraph<T>> extends DrawableObject
An abstract base class for plot graphs that supports self-referential generics to enable type-safe interaction with associated plot controls. Subclasses can define custom rendering logic and expose parameters that are adjustable via a linked PlotControl instance.

  • Methodendetails

    • getPlotSet

      public PlotSet<T> getPlotSet()
      Returns the plot set that owns this graph. This reference is used to access shared context such as grid settings, application state, or lifecycle callbacks.
      Gibt zurück:
      the associated PlotSet instance, or null if not yet assigned

    • setPlotSet

      public void setPlotSet(PlotSet<T> plotSet)
      Associates this graph with a specific plot set. This method is typically called automatically when the graph is added to a plot set via PlotSet.addGraph(PlotGraph) and should not be invoked manually under normal circumstances.
      Parameter:
      plotSet - the PlotSet instance to associate with this graph

    • setPlotControl

      public void setPlotControl(PlotControl<T> control)
      Associates this graph with a plot control window. The control can later be shown or hidden using showPlotControl() and hidePlotControl().
      Parameter:
      control - the plot control instance to link with this graph

    • hasTitle

      public boolean hasTitle()

    • configureGraphics

      public void configureGraphics(Graphics g)
      Customizes rendering using the basic Graphics context. Subclasses may override this method to provide additional drawing logic. This implementation does nothing by default.
      Parameter:
      g - the basic graphics context

    • configureGraphics2D

      public void configureGraphics2D(Graphics2D g)
      Customizes rendering using the enhanced Graphics2D context. Subclasses should override this method to define how the plot is drawn. This implementation does nothing by default.
      Parameter:
      g - the enhanced 2D graphics context
